# id: # libdictenstein's ABI invariant registry (traceability: model <-> invariant <-> test <-> gate).
# strength ladder: rocq-unbounded > tlaps-unbounded > apalache-inductive > verus > smt-dual > tlc-bounded > test-pinned.
#   - tlc-bounded rows carry their upgrade rung in the model's banner; a failed upgrade attempt
#     must be recorded in docs/bindings/FINDINGS_LEDGER.md for the row to remain bounded.
#   - test-pinned is reserved for finite, exhaustively enumerated surfaces with no residual
#     unbounded content (the law column must say why).

law: captured revisions are immune to every later publish (immutable-capture law)
gate: verify-formal-correspondence.sh (TLC + negative control) + cargo test --features ffi --test ffi_snapshot_law

law: a fresh capture observes exactly the currently published contents
compact and checkpoint publish content-preserving revisions

checkpointed state reopens byte-for-byte against the oracle (persistent create/CRUD/checkpoint/reopen cases exhaustively pinned against the oracle; residual unbounded content lives in the engine's own proven WAL specs)
missing or conflicting persistent paths surface as I/O errors, never as silent successes (finite path-state cases exhaustively pinned)
published root and exact cardinality describe one atomic persistent-overlay revision
captured root and exact cardinality remain coherent after later publications
lazy id assignment is stable and idempotent for an already-exposed node
assignment is append-only: existing entries never move or change
ABI-local identifiers are unambiguous (injective over logical unfolded node occurrences)
memoized edge lists are write-once and locality-preserving
arena well-formedness (unique nodes, in-bounds children) is preserved by assignment and memoization
chunk quotient and slot remainder reconstruct every ABI node id with an in-bounds slot
every page fits its capacity, lies inside the edge list, and out_total never varies with the paging position
gate: make -C formal-verification/rocq + cargo test --features ffi --test ffi_resource_paging_proptest

law: pages decompose losslessly and the k-th page equals the k-th paged call
gate: make -C formal-verification/rocq + cargo test --features ffi --test ffi_resource_paging_proptest

law: every owned retain is released exactly once and borrows are ledger-neutral (retain/release/borrow cases exhaustively pinned; the protocol model is the interop lifecycle spec, cited not re-proven)
retained resources survive handle frees across threads (finite teardown orders exhaustively pinned under stress; lifetime law owned by the interop lifecycle model)
both status tables are exact bijections onto their declared u32 ranges
gate: make -C formal-verification/rocq + cargo test --features ffi --test ffi_status_matrix

law: the project and interop tables diverge above code 7 by design; raw integer reuse provably misroutes
gate: make -C formal-verification/rocq + cargo test --features ffi --test ffi_status_matrix

law: failures set a non-empty thread-local message and never disturb other threads (finite observation protocol exhaustively pinned)
per-backend capability dispatch matches the published kind and capability bits (full backend-by-operation matrix exhaustively pinned)
